keyFindings.description: The incomplete event's hold names dest.key() for every destination, delivered ones included; a delivered role route gets the role's current holder in resolveRoleHolders (role.go:99-105), so after the holder moves from O to N an incomplete event E whose role route reached O names agent.N, a later event C's forward to N is neither held nor chained (E's delivered destination is skipped at :417), and when E's read later succeeds and names N as a thread or document session it reaches N after C. Fix: skip delivered destinations in that loop (the loop over delivered already names their recorded subjects), with a test.

fastFollow: One recursive loadRecipients in place of loadRecipients plus bisectRecipients (lookups.go:302-341).
verifiedCorrect: Not-due events take their recipient reads again; a healthy not-due event holds only its unreached keys.
Bisection answers or fails every id exactly once; one broken row costs 2*ceil(log2 n) extra statements; a non-refused failure fails the remaining ids.
refusedStatement: ConnectError checked before PgError; classes 08, 40, 53, 57, 58 and an ended ctx are not refused statements.
